title: (Updated) Microsoft Viva Engage: Retiring the legacy live event creation option in Engage
summary: Starting December 7, 2026, Microsoft Viva Engage will retire the legacy live event creation option. Organizers can no longer create legacy events but can still use Broadcast, Meeting, and Async Engage events. Existing legacy events will run as planned. Update organizers and documentation accordingly.
body:
Updated November 23, 2026: We have updated the timeline and content. Thank you for your patience. 

[What and why] 

We're retiring the legacy live event experience in Engage. Starting December 7, 2026, users will no longer be able to create new events with the legacy option, which appears as the link "Want to schedule an event with the legacy live event feature? Click here." 

This change doesn't affect Engage events. Organizers can still create all Engage event types from communities and storylines: 

- Broadcast events (powered by Teams town hall) - Meeting events (powered by Teams webinar) - Async events [Rollout schedule] 

December 7, 2026: The legacy live event creation option is removed from Engage. Previously scheduled legacy events will run as planned. 

[Impact on your organization] 

Who is affected 

- Event organizers who still create events with the legacy live event option in Engage. - Organizers who already use Engage events won't see any change. Platforms and services 

- Microsoft Viva Engage [What will happen] 

- The legacy live event link will no longer appear when organizers create an event in Engage. - Legacy events that were already scheduled will continue to run as planned. - Engage events (Broadcast, Meeting and Async) will stay available from communities and storylines, with no change to how they work. [Action required and recommendations] 

- We recommend that you: Tell organizers who use the legacy option about this change before December 7, 2026. - Point organizers to Engage events for new and upcoming events. - Update any internal documentation, training materials or guidance that mentions the legacy live event option. [Learn more] 

Engage events overview | Microsoft Support 

https://support-uat.microsoft.com/en-us/viva/engage/engage-events-overview 

Organize an Engage event | Microsoft Support 

https://support.microsoft.com/viva/engage/organize-an-engage-event

Updated November 23, 2026: We have updated the timeline and content. Thank you for your patience. 

[What and why] 

We're retiring the legacy live event experience in Engage. Starting December 7, 2026, users will no longer be able to create new events with the legacy option, which appears as the link "Want to schedule an event with the legacy live event feature? Click here." 

This change doesn't affect Engage events. Organizers can still create all Engage event types from communities and storylines: 

  • Broadcast events (powered by Teams town hall) 
  • Meeting events (powered by Teams webinar) 
  • Async events 

[Rollout schedule] 

December 7, 2026: The legacy live event creation option is removed from Engage. Previously scheduled legacy events will run as planned. 

[Impact on your organization] 

Who is affected 

  • Event organizers who still create events with the legacy live event option in Engage. 
  • Organizers who already use Engage events won't see any change. 

Platforms and services 

  • Microsoft Viva Engage 

[What will happen] 

  • The legacy live event link will no longer appear when organizers create an event in Engage. 
  • Legacy events that were already scheduled will continue to run as planned. 
  • Engage events (Broadcast, Meeting and Async) will stay available from communities and storylines, with no change to how they work. 

[Action required and recommendations] 

  • We recommend that you: Tell organizers who use the legacy option about this change before December 7, 2026. 
  • Point organizers to Engage events for new and upcoming events. 
  • Update any internal documentation, training materials or guidance that mentions the legacy live event option. 

[Learn more]
